name: Measurements on captures
summary: Measuring points, distances, areas and drone surfaces in the viewer, sharing measurements, and turning them into progress assets.

nfr.statement: Time to return a drone height profile or cut/fill result, which may be calculated on first view.
nfr.open_question: Is a wait acceptable on first view, or must results be precomputed?

requirements.title: Measurements belong to a dated snapshot, and are private unless shared
requirements.statement: A measurement is tied to the snapshot for its date in the project's time zone; giving either the date or the snapshot fills in the other. A measurement is private unless shared, and unsharing removes its assignees.

acceptance_criteria.given: A shared measurement with two assignees
acceptance_criteria.then: It has no assignees, and other users no longer see it

requirements.title: A categorised measurement also creates a progress asset
requirements.statement: A measurement saved with a progress category also creates a linked progress asset in that category's first stage: a point becomes a circle, a distance a polyline, an area a polygon. If creating the asset fails, the measurement is still saved.
open_checks: A successful measurement doesn't prove the asset exists; assuming the first stage, failed links and repeated syncs need reconciliation

acceptance_criteria.given: A user draws an area measurement with category Drywall
acceptance_criteria.then: A polygon progress asset appears in Drywall's first stage

requirements.title: Drone surface measurements are calculated on first view
requirements.statement: Viewing a drone height profile or cut/fill measurement calculates it from the surface model if it isn't stored yet (100 points for profiles), and saves the result for next time.

acceptance_criteria.given: A height-profile measurement viewed for the first time on a date
acceptance_criteria.then: The profile is calculated and stored, and a second view uses the stored result
